snippet.title: Elise and the Spellbinding Marionette - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Elise is a small-town adventurer making a living completing quests posted in the town tavern. During a routine job, she finds a girl collapsed by the side of the road. Not one to leave a person in distress behind, Elise carries the girl back to town.
